actions.action: Observe the plant for clues on where to cut before pruning
Remove dead, dying, damaged or diseased parts as soon as possible
Decide on a goal for the plant to guide further cuts
Prune no more than one-third of the plant overall, timed relative to flowering
Monitor new shoots and prune out unwanted ones
Feed the plant after pruning, following fertilizer label instructions (organic suggested)
